entities.name: Parish Church of the Nativity of the Virgin Mary, Mellieħa
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Parish Church of the Nativity of the Virgin Mary is a Roman Catholic parish church in Mellieħa, Malta, dedicated to the Nativity of Mary. It was built between 1881 and 1898, and the dome and bell towers were completed between 1920 and 1940.
